signals.title: AccountingInvoiceManagementPage: create/delete mutations have no onError — silent invoice failures
evidence: AccountingInvoiceManagementPage.tsx:36-42 — createMutation (invoicesApiCreate) has only onSuccess; no onError, component never reads isError. Failed create leaves form open with no feedback (isPending flips back, setIsCreating stays true).

AccountingInvoiceManagementPage.tsx:44-49,88-91 — deleteMutation is likewise onSuccess-only. Failed delete is silent (no toast/alert/isError branch); list only invalidated on success so row stays and user believes nothing happened.
This is the sole page in the ppt-web-ui segment whose write mutations surface no error state (sibling pages read isError + render role=alert blocks).
Impact: medium — financial write paths (issue / delete invoice) where silent failure lets a manager believe an invoice was created or removed when it was not.

signals.title: ppt-web: 103 hardcoded English aria-label attributes across feature components — screen readers hear English on sk/cs/de
evidence: 103 hardcoded English aria-label attributes across ppt-web feature components are not wrapped in react-i18next t(...) — screen-reader users on sk/cs/de locales hear English accessibility labels even though visible copy is translated. grep pattern used: `grep -rn 'aria-label="[A-Z]' frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features --include='*.tsx' | grep -v 't('` => 103 hits.

Representative sites: community/PostCard.tsx:164, financial/InvoiceDetail.tsx:42,61, faults/TriageFaultDialog.tsx:87, disputes/EvidenceUploader.tsx:165,183, government-portal/SubmissionPreviewModal.tsx:102.
Distinct from prior ppt-web-ui i18n finding (window.confirm/alert copy) — this is the aria-label surface. Impact: low — accessibility/i18n gap, no functional break.

signals.title: SessionsPage double-casts through unknown to hand-maintained interface — defeats API-boundary type-check
evidence: SessionsPage.tsx:84 — `const sessions = (sessionsQuery.data?.sessions ?? []) as unknown as SessionRow[];` double-casts generated-client response through `unknown` into a local SessionRow interface (:22, 'mirrors the backend SessionInfo DTO'). If backend DTO drifts (isCurrent → is_current, etc.), compile does not catch it; `sessions.some((s) => !s.isCurrent)` silently reads undefined.
Only `as unknown as` boundary cast in the segment. Fix: consume generated client's Session type directly.
Impact: low — no current runtime bug, but the cast removes the compile-time guard on a security-relevant page (active-session list / revoke).
